Domestic LPG Cylinder KYC Deadline Looms for Consumers

Domestic LPG cylinder consumers are being urged to complete their biometric e-KYC (Know Your Customer) verification linked to Aadhaar. Reports indicate that failure to do so by August 16 could lead to the suspension of cylinder supply. This verification process is presented as necessary to ensure continued access to cooking gas cylinders.
